Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to make a traditional meat‑based lasagna (you can adjust or add variations as you like): | Category | Typical Ingredients | |----------|---------------------| | **Pasta** | • 12–15 sheets of lasagna noodles (regular or no‑boil) | | **Meat Sauce** | • 1 lb ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork)
• 1 small onion, finely chopped
• 2–3 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes or whole‑tomato sauce
• 1 can (6 oz) tomato paste
• 1 cup beef or vegetable broth (optional, for extra moisture)
• 1 tsp dried oregano
• 1 tsp dried basil
• ½ tsp dried thyme
• Salt & pepper to taste | | **Ricotta Layer** | • 15 oz ricotta cheese
• 1 egg (helps bind)
• ¼ cup grated Parmesan
• Pinch of nutmeg (optional)
• Salt & pepper | | **Mozzarella Layer** | • 2–3 cups shredded mozzarella (part‑moist or part‑shelf) | | **Parmesan** | • 1–2 cups grated Parmesan (for topping) | | **Egg** | • 1–2 eggs (for binding the ricotta mixture) | | **Herbs & Seasonings** | • Fresh basil or parsley for garnish (optional) | | **Optional Extras** | • Sautéed spinach or kale
• Sliced mushrooms
• Red pepper flakes for heat
• A splash of white wine in the sauce | ### Quick Prep Tips 1. **Cook the noodles** according to package instructions (or use no‑boil sheets). Drain and set aside. 2. **Brown the meat** with onions and garlic; add tomatoes, broth, and herbs; simmer 20–30 min. 3. **Mix ricotta** with egg, Parmesan, salt, pepper, and nutmeg. 4. **Layer**: Start with a thin sauce layer, then noodles, ricotta, mozzarella, sauce, repeat until all layers are used. Finish with mozzarella + Parmesan on top. 5. **Bake** at 375 °F (190 °C) for 45–55 min, covered with foil for the first 30 min, then uncovered for the last 15 min to brown the top. Let rest 10–15 min before serving. Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
